_excluded: Appearance.md from the same folder is deliberately never transcribed here or anywhere in this repo: it names real people and must never enter a public project.
_gaps: Color_Combination.md and Autumn_Type_Color_Palette_and_Style.md were written as two separate personal-color-analysis notes and were never reconciled — the first only ever recorded a 'Winter' season type, the second is titled 'Autumn Type'. Both are kept verbatim under their own heading rather than guessing which one is current.
Outfit_Planner.md has content for Monday only; the rest of the week was empty in the source.

colorAnalysis.note: From Color_Combination.md. Describes the Winter season type generically (its own diagnostic traits), not confirmed here as Philipp's own type — see _gaps.
colorAnalysis.traits: Extreme contrast between skin, hair and eyes. Common among Southern Europeans, Asians, and people with black skin.
colorAnalysis.skin: Porcelain-like, cool in lighter skin, slightly olive in darker skin
colorAnalysis.tan: None or only slight in lighter skin, fast tanning in darker skin
colorAnalysis.hair: Dark brown to blue-black; grey hair shows strong contrast against the skin
colorAnalysis.eyes: Intense blue, green, cool grey, or dark brown to almost black
colorAnalysis.avoid: No orange, no blue-violet other than the listed purples, no washed-out violet tones

seasonalWardrobe.note: From Autumn_Type_Color_Palette_and_Style.md — a baseline palette plus one capsule per calendar season, not per color-analysis type.
seasonalWardrobe.paletteNote: Warm, earthy tones: olive green, rust red, mustard yellow, chocolate brown, copper, terracotta, petrol, camel.
seasonalWardrobe.styleNote: Natural fabrics — wool, cotton, leather — suit this palette well. Avoid bright, cool colors; stay muted and warm.

seasons.heading: Light Fabrics and Warm Shades
seasons.tops: Light shirts or polo shirts in apricot, coral, or warm beige
seasons.outerwear: Lightweight transitional jackets in olive green or camel
seasons.shoes: Loafers or light leather shoes in brown or cognac tones

seasons.heading: Breezy Clothing in Natural Colors
seasons.tops: Linen shirts or T-shirts in warm white, terracotta, or mustard yellow
seasons.bottoms: Shorts in olive green or beige
seasons.accessories: Straw hats or sunglasses with brown lenses
seasons.shoes: Sandals or espadrilles in natural tones

seasons.heading: Layering with Warm Colors
seasons.tops: Sweaters or cardigans in rust red, dark green, or chocolate brown
seasons.outerwear: Transitional jackets or coats in camel or olive green
seasons.bottoms: Jeans or corduroy pants in dark brown or mustard yellow
seasons.shoes: Ankle boots or boots in brown or cognac tones

seasons.heading: Warm Fabrics and Deep Tones
seasons.tops: Turtleneck sweaters or flannel shirts in dark green, burgundy, or petrol
seasons.outerwear: Wool coats or parkas in chocolate brown or dark olive
seasons.bottoms: Thermal pants or jeans in dark brown or black
seasons.shoes: Lined boots in dark brown tones
